F41.claim: the sales catalogs: Belgium, France, Germany, Great Britain, the Netherlands and Scandinavia, 1650–1945; over 12 million resources from more than 22,000 catalogs (stated in the sales-catalog section)

F42.quote: Additionally, the dataset features bibliographic information for over 8,700 German sales from 1900 to 1945. More than 830,000 auction records have been digitally extracted, with links to full PDFs hosted at the Heidelberg University Library .
F42.claim: German sales 1900–1945: over 8,700 sales, more than 830,000 auction records, linked to Heidelberg University Library's PDFs

F43.quote: These records, dating from 1520 to 1880, provide critical insights into the contents of historical collections in France, Italy, Germany, the Netherlands, and Spain. The Provenance Index includes over 276,000 individual records extracted from more than 13,000 archival documents.
F43.claim: the archival inventories: 1520–1880, France, Italy, Germany, the Netherlands, Spain; over 276,000 records from more than 13,000 documents

F44.locus: § Collectors Files; § Payments to Artists; § Public Collections
F44.quote: The Collectors Files database indexes approximately 20,000 folders containing information about international collectors, dealers, auctioneers, and art institutions from the late Middle Ages to the present. … This database contains approximately 1,000 payments recorded in Rome between 1576 and 1711. … Covering over 95,000 records spanning from 1500 to 1990, it offers valuable insights into the ownership histories and institutional holdings of artworks.
F44.claim: the complementary databases counted: about 20,000 collectors' folders; about 1,000 payments in Rome, 1576–1711; over 95,000 public-collection records, 1500–1990
F44.lineage: the complementary databases: Collectors Files, Payments to Artists, Public Collections

F45.claim: the encyclopedia has no article for the Index: its title redirects to the operator's article
F45.lineage: the encyclopedia: a redirect to the operator

F46.quote: Among the electronic databases from the former Getty Information Institute that GRI continues to produce are: … Getty Provenance Index which holds records of collections, auction sales and other information for researching the art market and the provenance of works.
F46.claim: the operator's article lists the Index among the electronic databases 'from the former Getty Information Institute' that the Research Institute continues to produce, holding records of collections and auction sales for research on the art market and provenance
F46.lineage: the encyclopedia: a redirect to the operator
